checks.detail: Real GFM checkboxes toggle; code stays text and author HTML input stays disabled.

checks.name: Tab / Space and Undo / Redo
checks.detail: Tab focuses first and next task after enabling WKPreferences.tabFocusesLinks. Space changes one task; Cmd+Z restores it and Cmd+Shift+Z reapplies it.

checks.name: editing / line changes / first click
checks.detail: Replaced a paragraph with three lines, then one click on a nested task committed paragraph and changed the correct task without another editor. Delayed-blur issue fixed and retested.

checks.name: explicit Save / close Save / reopen
checks.detail: Cmd+S updated only the intended markers and edited paragraph. Close > Save closed window. Reopening showed matching states.

checks.name: Cancel / Don't Save
checks.detail: Cancel kept the checked draft and window; Don't Save closed and preserved original source (byte comparison).

checks.name: two document isolation and switching
checks.detail: Second document checked draft remained checked across Window menu switches while first showed its independently saved states. Second disk remained unchecked before Save.

checks.name: real permission failure and retry
checks.detail: Made only the temporary fixture directory read-only, invoked Save and observed permission alert. Draft/window stayed checked, disk stayed unchecked. Restored directory permissions and Save wrote checked state.

checks.name: final build / content tab / three nested quote tasks
checks.detail: Relaunched final build after source-map refinement. All three tasks enabled, clicked deepest task and saved; exact source comparison confirmed only its state character changed.

checks.name: scroll / alignment / focus visuals
checks.detail: Content stayed at same visible position; saved view shows checked deepest task and focus ring. Hosted suite additionally checks numeric window.scrollY.

checks.name: cleanup
checks.detail: Closed temporary documents and quit Debug app. Installed /Applications/Bloct.app was not replaced.
